parsedVerdict.reasoning: The domain module covers one concern: orders and product stock. Each file is either an entity (Order, OrderItem, Product), the state rules (order-state.ts), a port (OrderRepository, ProductRepository, IdGenerator), an error type (errors.ts), or the domain service (StockReservationService). Each rule lives in one place. The transition rules are only in order-state.ts, and Order calls nextStateOf/isCancellable. The stock check is only in Product.canReserve, and StockReservationService calls it to pre-check every item before reserving any; repeating the error type there is not a second copy of the rule. OrderItem (quantity must be a positive integer) and Product (stock must be a non-negative integer) check different rules, so neither duplicates the other. StockReservationService reaches persistence only through the injected ProductRepository port, and no file uses a database or ORM directly. No candidate flags were raised.
